translation:
(Tianshu is the name of a foot Yangming point, beside the navel; this refers to level with the navel.)
From Tianshu down to the pubic bone (橫骨), it is six and a half cun long; the pubic bone is six and a half cun wide horizontally. (The bone below the hairline is called the pubic bone.)
[Comment] These are the ancient numbers; compared with the present use of the upper and lower point methods, many do not agree. One should follow the later chest and abdomen folding method as the standard. Between the two thighs (髀), the width is six and a half cun.
